title: OmniDex Scroll Test Notice
subtitle: Testing long content rendering and scrolling behavior
description:
This is a LONG DESCRIPTION TEST for OmniDex notice popup scrolling behavior.

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION
OmniDex Remote Notice System is designed to handle dynamic content fetched from GitHub in real time. This test is specifically created to verify whether the popup UI correctly supports vertical scrolling when content exceeds the visible screen height.

SECTION 2: PURPOSE OF THIS TEST
The purpose of this notice is to ensure that users can scroll through long announcements without layout breaking, text clipping, or UI overflow issues. Many apps fail when dynamic remote content becomes too large, so this test ensures stability under heavy content load.

SECTION 3: TECHNICAL DETAILS
The system uses a JSON-based remote configuration file hosted on GitHub. The Android app fetches this file at runtime, parses it using Kotlin serialization or Gson/Moshi, and then renders it inside a Material 3 dialog or custom bottom sheet UI.

SECTION 4: EXPECTED BEHAVIOR
- The popup must not crash under long text
- The popup must allow vertical scrolling
- Buttons must remain accessible (sticky or bottom-aligned)
- Image (if present) should not break layout
- Text should wrap properly and remain readable

Philosophy Section:
Technology evolves rapidly, and systems like OmniDex demonstrate how remote configuration can replace traditional hardcoded UI elements. By separating backend logic from application builds, developers gain flexibility, scalability, and instant update capability without requiring users to download new versions.
